name: zatca-relay
description: SA'DA H2O — ZATCA (Fatoora) Phase-2 e-invoicing signing relay. Holds the EGS private key + CSID certificate, signs UBL 2.1 invoices with ECDSA secp256k1, builds the Phase-2 QR, and reports/clears invoices to ZATCA. Runs on a host (like the SMS relay); the Cloudflare Worker and dashboard call it over HTTPS. The private key NEVER leaves this service.
